knowledge:
- key_parameters: upstreamOffset=The number of amino acids upstream of the anchoring site to include ;; downstreamOffset=The number of amino acids downstream of the anchoring site to include ;; anchorAA=The character representing the anchoring amino acid (e.g., "*" or "s") ;; background=The background model type, such as "wholeProteome" ;; testType=The statistical test to perform, either "fisher" (Fisher's exact test) or "ztest" (Z-test) ;; groupingScheme=The amino acid grouping scheme to use (e.g., "chemistry_property_Mahler_group", "charge_group", "consensus_similarity_SF_group", "hydrophobicity_KD", or "custom_group") ;; groupingSymbol=The symbols representing the grouped amino acids, typically retrieved using getGroupingSymbol()
- alternatives: seqlogo=R package for drawing sequence logos for a single DNA motif ;; motifStack=R package for depicting individual or multiple motifs for AA, DNA, and RNA sequences ;; webLogo=Web tool relying on information theory (less dynamic, doesn't handle differential usage against custom backgrounds as dynamically as probability-based tools) ;; iceLogo=Java tool using probability theory for differential AA usage, but limited to individual amino acid levels (cannot group by physical/chemical properties)
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing aligned or unaligned peptide sequences (e.g., post-translational modification sites, protease cleavage sites) to find over- or under-represented amino acids or amino acid property groups compared to a specific background (like the whole proteome or a random set of sequences).
- pitfalls: BiomaRt server might not respond, so wrap fetchSequence in try() or use local fasta files with prepareProteome and formatSequence ;; Input data with multiple anchoring AAs must be cleaned up using cleanPeptides before fetching sequences ;; Custom grouping schemes must be added using addScheme before calling testDAU with groupingScheme = "custom_group"

workflows.name: biomart_peptide_analysis
workflows.intent: Fetch peptide sequences from BioMart using gene identifiers and anchoring positions, build a background model, perform differential amino acid usage (DAU) testing, and visualize the results.
input: peptides4dagLogo.csv (CSV file containing gene identifiers, anchoring amino acids, and peptide subsequences)
workflows.stages: 1. Clean input peptides using cleanPeptides ;; 2. Fetch sequences from BioMart using fetchSequence ;; 3. Prepare a proteome background using prepareProteome ;; 4. Build a background model using buildBackgroundModel ;; 5. Test for differential amino acid usage (DAU) using testDAU ;; 6. Visualize results using dagHeatmap and dagLogo
workflows.code:
dat <- read.csv(system.file("extdata", "peptides4dagLogo.csv",
            package="dagLogo"))
dat <- unique(cleanPeptides(dat, anchors = c("s", "t")))
mart <- useMart("ensembl", "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
seq <- fetchSequence(toupper(as.character(dat$symbol)), 
                     type="hgnc_symbol",
                     anchorAA=as.character(dat$anchor),
                     anchorPos=as.character(dat$peptides), 
                     mart=mart, 
                     upstreamOffset=7, 
                     downstreamOffset=7)
proteome <- prepareProteome("UniProt", species = "Homo sapiens")
bg_ztest <- buildBackgroundModel(seq, background = "wholeProteome", 
                                 proteome = proteome, testType = "ztest")
t0 <- testDAU(seq, dagBackground = bg_ztest)
dagHeatmap(t0)
dagLogo(t0)

workflows.name: fasta_peptide_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform differential amino acid usage analysis using a local FASTA file for the proteome and a text file of peptide sequences.
workflows.stages: 1. Read peptide sequences from a text file ;; 2. Prepare a proteome object from a local FASTA file using prepareProteome ;; 3. Format peptide sequences using formatSequence ;; 4. Build a background model using buildBackgroundModel ;; 5. Test for differential amino acid usage (DAU) with or without grouping using testDAU ;; 6. Visualize results using dagHeatmap and dagLogo
workflows.code:
dat <- unlist(read.delim(system.file("extdata", "grB.txt", package = "dagLogo"),
                        header = F, as.is = TRUE))
proteome <- prepareProteome(fasta = system.file("extdata",
                                                "HUMAN.fasta",
                                                package = "dagLogo"), 
                            species = "Homo sapiens")
seq <- formatSequence(seq = dat, proteome = proteome, upstreamOffset = 14,
                      downstreamOffset = 15)
bg_ztest <- buildBackgroundModel(seq, background = "wholeProteome", 
                                 proteome = proteome, testType = "ztest")
t0 <- testDAU(seq, dagBackground = bg_ztest)
t1 <- testDAU(dagPeptides = seq, dagBackground = bg_ztest,
              groupingScheme = "chemistry_property_Mahler_group")
t2 <- testDAU(dagPeptides = seq, dagBackground = bg_ztest, 
              groupingScheme = "charge_group")
t3 <- testDAU(dagPeptides = seq, dagBackground = bg_ztest, 
              groupingScheme = "consensus_similarity_SF_group")
t4 <- testDAU(dagPeptides = seq, dagBackground = bg_ztest, 
              groupingScheme = "hydrophobicity_KD")
color = c(LVIMC = "#33FF00", AGSTP = "#CCFF00",
          FYW = '#00FF66', EDNQKRH = "#FF0066")
symbol = c(LVIMC = "L", AGSTP = "A", FYW = "F", EDNQKRH = "E")
group = list(
    LVIMC = c("L", "V", "I", "M", "C"), 
    AGSTP = c("A", "G", "S", "T", "P"),
    FYW = c("F", "Y", "W"),
    EDNQKRH = c("E", "D", "N", "Q", "K", "R", "H"))
addScheme(color = color, symbol = symbol, group = group) 
t5 <- testDAU(dagPeptides = seq, dagBackground = bg_ztest, 
              groupingScheme = "custom_group")
dagHeatmap(t0)
dagLogo(t0)
dagLogo(t1, groupingSymbol = getGroupingSymbol(t1@group), legend = TRUE)
dagLogo(t2, groupingSymbol = getGroupingSymbol(t2@group), legend = TRUE)
dagLogo(t3, groupingSymbol = getGroupingSymbol(t3@group), legend = TRUE)
dagLogo(t4, groupingSymbol = getGroupingSymbol(t4@group), legend = TRUE)
